🔄

What is ClosetSwap?

A full-stack clothing exchange platform where users list items from their wardrobe, pin styles they want, and propose direct swaps — no money, just trade. Built end-to-end solo: product design, database architecture, auth, Chrome & Safari extensions, and UI. Currently in active development.
